headline: ‘Showgirls’: The Gratuitous, Surreal Bomb That Was Maybe Brilliant
context: The reception to Paul Verhoeven’s lurid 1995 melodrama starring Elizabeth Berkley, Kyle MacLachlan and Gina Gershon was humiliating, but it’s since become a thought-provoking camp favorite.
